{{Quote|The Facinorous, Moliminous, Nefandous, Numamorous ''[sic]'' Adler Roty|Part of advertisement for Adler Roty's performance on Coruscant|<ref name="Adler Ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/600_3.gif|text=Adler Roty}}</ref>}}
'''Adler Roty''' was a professional stage performer who claimed to be one of the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]],<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia - Adler" /> an ancient sect of [[Magic/Legends|sorcerers]] based on<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia - Tund">{{CSWECite|III|180|Sorcerers of Tund}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia - Tund" /> In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The advert can appear on any of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] articles that range from {{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}} to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|56||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #56}}. These articles date themselves to 13:2:28 [[Great ReSynchronization|G.R.S.]] and 13.5.15 G.R.S, which correspond to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], respectively, according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Roty's new show at the [[CoCo District Theatre]]<ref name="Adler Ad" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> Coruscant was advertised on [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. The advertisement used a trademarked tag-line, "It's not [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]! It's magic!" The advert also featured a [[Robe/Legends|robed]] figure.<ref name="Adler Ad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adler Roty was first mentioned in an advertisement<ref name="Adler Ad" /> on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]]<ref name="HoloNet News">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]].</ref> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #45]], the first set of articles,<ref name="HNN45">{{Hnn|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}}</ref> was published to the ''HoloNet News'' website on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> The word ''numamorous'' that appears in the advert<ref name="Adler Ad" /> is a misspelling of the word ''nummamorous'', meaning a person who loves money.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.allhotelscalifornia.com/kokogiakcom/logolepsy/ow_n.html#nummamorous|text=Luciferous Logolepsy - N|work=KOKOGIAK|archivedate=20180619073011}}</ref>
